query: How do I apply for road widening proposals to PWD in Tamil Nadu?
reference_answer:
Applying for Road Widening Proposals:
To apply, submit a proposal to the concerned PWD Divisional Office, along with required documents such as land ownership records and a detailed project report. The proposal will be reviewed and processed according to PWD guidelines.
answer: To apply for road widening proposals in Tamil Nadu, contact the Public Works Department (PWD) directly. Visit their official website or visit their offices in person to fill out an application form. Ensure you have all necessary documents ready, such forget about the application process details.
